products.name: The Magnum Cake
products.short: Layered vanilla sponge under poured milk and white chocolate, finished with roasted nuts.
products.desc: Our most sought-after dessert. A tall wedge of layered vanilla sponge, drowned in molten milk chocolate, then white chocolate, and finished with a shower of roasted nuts.

products.name: Milk Cake
products.short: Golden sponge in chilled sweet milk, hand-piped cream, one blueberry.
products.desc: A golden sponge soaked through and resting in a pool of chilled sweet milk, finished with a ribbon of hand-piped cream and a single blueberry. Served cold.

products.name: Hazelnut Fudge Brownie
products.short: Crackle top, molten fudge centre, roasted hazelnuts.
products.desc: The one the name is for. A paper-thin crackle top over a dense, fudgy centre, finished with a scatter of roasted hazelnuts. Rich enough to share, good enough not to.

products.name: Marble Brownie Stack
products.short: Three thick-cut brownies with a golden marbled swirl.
products.desc: Three thick-cut brownies, each folded with a golden swirl through dark chocolate. Stacked for the table or boxed for later.

products.name: Paneer Croissant Sandwich
products.short: Seeded butter croissant, spiced paneer, crisp lettuce, fries.
products.desc: A seeded butter croissant split and filled with spiced paneer and crisp lettuce. Comes with slaw and a stack of fries.

products.name: Korean Sesame Glaze Bowl
products.short: Crisp bites in a dark sticky glaze, sesame, fresh slaw.
products.desc: Crisp bites tossed in a dark, sticky Korean-style glaze and showered with sesame. A cool cabbage slaw on the side keeps things honest.

products.name: Avocado Toast
products.short: Smashed avocado, cherry tomato, crumbled cheese, cracked pepper.
products.desc: The other half of our name. Thick toast under a generous layer of smashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, crumbled cheese and cracked pepper, with a small salad alongside.

products.name: Mini Croissant Bowl
products.short: Mini croissants in dark, milk and white chocolate.
products.desc: A bowl of mini croissants sitting in three chocolates: dark, milk and white. Bring a spoon and a friend.

products.name: Fig & Berry French Toast
products.short: Thick-cut French toast, whipped cream, fresh fig, blueberries.
products.desc: Thick-cut French toast under a cloud of whipped cream, fresh fig and blueberries, finished with a single flower.

products.name: Grilled Panini
products.short: Pressed and charred, with a side of slaw.
products.desc: Pressed on the grill until the lines char and the middle melts. Served with fresh slaw.

products.name: Iced Ube Latte
products.short: Purple ube whisked by hand, poured over iced milk.
products.desc: Ube whisked by hand until smooth, then poured slowly over iced milk so the purple settles in layers.

products.name: Layered Matcha
products.short: Whisked matcha layered over a berry cream.
products.desc: Bright whisked matcha layered over a soft berry cream. Stir it, or do not.

products.name: Iced Latte
products.short: Espresso and cold milk over ice.
products.desc: Espresso and cold milk over ice. Simple, cold and exactly what it should be.
